collections.name: Moves Ahead 1: Vision in Calculating Mate
collections.author: AlanB
collections.description: Calculation and visualization trainer featuring checkmate variations from master games (2300+ FIDE) with explicit candidate moves.

collections.name: The Checkmate Patterns Manual

collections.description: Comprehensive reference of 30 classic mating motifs (Anastasia, Boden, Epaulette, Arabian, Damiano, Greco, Morphy, etc.) across 1,000 positions.

collections.name: The Woodpecker Method
collections.author: GM Axel Smith & GM Hans Tikkanen

collections.name: 1001 Brilliant Checkmates

collections.description: Timeless classical collection of 995 forced checkmates and attacking combinations ideal for quick tactical puzzle Shorts.

collections.name: Dvoretsky's Endgame Manual

collections.name: Bobby Fischer: Tactics & Reversing Method
